## 正文

$## Summary

Onboards `mla_paged_decode_h8_ckv512_kpe64_ps1` for **Kimi K2.6** (`moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6`).

Kimi K2.6 is a multimodal variant of Kimi K2 that reuses the same DeepSeek V3-style text backbone (61 decoder layers, MLA attention, sparse MoE). All text-backbone attention/MoE/RMSNorm dimensions are identical to Kimi K2, so the existing Kimi K2 definition applies bit-for-bit — this PR simply attaches the `model:kimi-k2.6` tag and records coverage.

## Kernel details

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Op type | `mla_paged` |
| Stage | decode |
| num_qo_heads | 8 (64 total / TP=8) |
| head_dim_ckv | 512 |
| head_dim_kpe | 64 |
| page_size | 1 |
| q/kv dtype | bfloat16 |
| FlashInfer API | `flashinfer.mla.BatchMLAPagedAttentionWrapper` |
| Model | `moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6` (also Kimi K2) |
| Standard serving | TP=8, quantization=fp8 |

## Changes

- `flashinfer_trace/definitions/mla_paged/mla_paged_decode_h8_ckv512_kpe64_ps1.json`: add `model:kimi-k2.6` tag and broaden description.
- `docs/model_coverage.mdx`: add Kimi K2.6 row to summary and a new `## Kimi K2.6` detail section listing reusable Kimi K2 kernels.
